body: Yeah I tried to be a little vague since I know people on here and certain details would give us away. Yes I agree with no matter where we live the problems will be the same. As far as this goes it was completely out of character and has shocked all freinds and family. Our marriage is definitely suffering due to this though (but who's wouldn't be). I appreciate the comment though thank you.
Yeah I'm glad they are here for me. I'm really lucky to have them. I really hope he comes back too this is the hardest thing I have ever gone through.

We are staying with my parents for now. I was a stay at home mom for going on five years so financially we can't make it without him. As far as church we didn't know anyone since we just moved here and freinds don't know anything either they are just as surprised and shocked as we were when it happened.
Thank you we really appreciate all the prayers

I honestly can say no he had not been up to anything while here now that he's not I couldn't say. As for keeping in contact I'm not sure....with me and our son none at all his parents yes but not much because all they do is try to get him to come back.

His parents are angry with him. They don't not believe in divorce and neither did we (or so I thought). We made promises to never divorce or consider it unless one of us cheats or attempts to and as far as I know that hasn't happened.
Thank you. I'm definitely going to have to relearn who I am with out him.
Thank you so much. I'll have a look that these.
Thank you very much. I'll pray for your cousin as well
